description: Start one paid-and-judged verification run: the arena funds, executes the fixed 3-call suite itself, judges it, and builds the Layer 0 write-back events. An unknown or ineligible target is answered free, before payment. Paid via x402 on Solana (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalents: POST /run (standard), POST /run/full-service, POST /run/retest. Prices (RULED): standard single-endpoint run $25; full-service run $50; re-test run $10. What the standard $25 includes: one arena-executed verification run of a single endpoint — the fixed 3-call suite (1 free pre-check call judged on challenge quality + 2 settled paid calls with per-run varied inputs, executed by the arena, never by the seller), judging on settled / delivered / payload_valid / challenge_ok with latency recorded, one verdict (pass / partial / fail) with per-dimension summaries, Layer 0 write-back events (verification evidence, delivery-proof delta, and a state recommendation on pass only), leaderboard eligibility from the same evidence, and the run record retained as digests + call records (payloads never stored). The run price is the full price of the run — constituent test-call costs are the arena's cost, not an additional charge. The $50 full-service run includes the same suite executed for EVERY paid endpoint of one service, a verdict per endpoint, a service-level dimension summary, and write-back per endpoint. The $10 re-test includes an identical suite, judging and write-back for an endpoint the same seller has already run; a re-test inside the 24h reputation window is delivered in full but flagged reputation_counted: false.

endpoint_path.description: Optional: the specific paid endpoint path to test.

run_id.description: Optional: caller-chosen run id; one is generated when omitted.

seller_ref.description: Optional: the seller's reference for this run.

service_id.description: The Layer 0 service id to test (see arena_eligible).

tier.description: Optional price tier: standard ($25, default), full_service ($50), retest ($10; same seller must have a prior run of the target).

name: arena_run
